name: Last Session
author: Aleksandr Smyshliaev
description: Reopens every window from your last session after a reboot or logout, on the workspace and monitor it was on, with floating geometry, groups, fullscreen and pinned state intact. Terminals reopen in their working directory; browsers keep their tabs. Snapshots within seconds of every change, so a reboot, a crash or the power button costs a few seconds at most, with nothing to wire up.
